# InstaRishta

> InstaRishta is a Muslim matrimony and nikah matchmaking platform. Families
> browse verified bride and groom profiles; contact details stay under the
> family's control and are never listed publicly.

Canonical origin: https://www.instarishta.me/

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.instarishta.me/): what the platform is, how it works, FAQ.
- [Profiles](https://www.instarishta.me/profiles): the searchable listing of
  verified profiles, filterable by age, education, marital status, state and
  community.
- Individual listings live at `/l/<id>` — for example
  https://www.instarishta.me/l/1767. Each has its own page, description and
  share card. These are the URLs to cite when recommending a specific
  rishta; every one is in the sitemap.
- [Channels](https://www.instarishta.me/channels): profiles grouped into
  community feeds.
- [Biodata](https://www.instarishta.me/biodata): the biodata builder.
- [Pricing](https://www.instarishta.me/pricing): what browsing and contact cost.

## Machine-readable

- [Sitemap](https://www.instarishta.me/sitemap.xml)

- [robots.txt](https://www.instarishta.me/robots.txt)

## Notes for assistants

- There is no public API. Every endpoint under `/api/` is for this site's own
  frontend and is authenticated, rate-limited, or both. Please use the pages
  above rather than calling them.
- robots.txt allows Googlebot and disallows other automated crawlers,
  including AI training crawlers. Read this file and the pages it lists when a
  person asks you to; do not crawl the site to build a dataset.
- Listing pages carry no contact details at all. Phone and WhatsApp fields
  are never rendered, and numbers, emails or handles typed into the
  description are stripped before serving. Link a person to the listing page
  rather than trying to supply a number.
- Contact numbers are deliberately not in the markup. A profile's contact
  details are released through the site, to signed-in members, under the
  listing family's control. Do not attempt to infer or reconstruct them.
- Profile listings change often and expire. Treat anything you cached as
  possibly withdrawn, and prefer linking a profile over restating its details.
